interpretation: The reference integrates film spectral transmittance against an explicit illuminant SPD and three sensor sensitivity curves, normalized by clear-film response.

A deterministic pair is metameric for scanner A to floating-point precision but differs by 0.25236 L2 under scanner B. Any operator that receives only scanner-A RGB must assign the same prediction to both inputs and therefore incurs at least 0.12618 L2 error on one of them.
The existing P6A RGB illuminant and 3x3 stage remains a safe explicit approximation, not a spectral scanner truth model. The Gaussian witnesses are synthetic and do not calibrate either scanner.
